items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: I went to see Tommy Thomas. So Tommy said, well, what are we going to do?

ctx.x: Who was managing that, uh? Happy Shillin. He and Fisher left? And, uh, Freddie Williams. Uh-huh.

Piano player Williams? Yeah. And, uh. Wanted to come back to New Orleans? Uh, no, Williams was a drummer. Yeah, they came back. Williams, uh. You were playing the piano with them still? Yeah. Uh-huh. Georgie Barth was a trumpet player. So I, I looked around and I asked the woman landlady, let's take a look at their room. And sure enough, so I went over to the cafe and the colored fella cleaning up. And I asked him, he said, oh, he come in, took the drums and everything. I didn't know a thing about it. So I was…
just two of them left? Oh, no, just me. Yeah, there are three or four of them at Goldman? Sure. All the band left
